t: Command picture hanging strips offer a simple, damage-free solution for mounting items on a variety of smooth surfaces. No nails, screws or tools are needed, simply press to apply. The strips lock together to hold items securely in place and can be removed or repositioned without leaving holes, marks or sticky residue. Suitable for painted walls, finished wood, painted concrete cinder blocks, laminate, glass, metal and tiles. Ideal for hanging picture frames, wall art, small mirrors, clocks, signs, boards and other home decor. Pack includes 4 pairs of medium and 8 pairs of large white strips (24 strips total). Includes full instructions for correct application. For indoor use only.
